errors: 16.text: the opening subject has no verb, leaving a broken fragment before the semicolon and losing the causal force of the English absolute ("El pacto que se hizo con Adán, no solo para él mismo...; toda la humanidad")
25.text: "once" is weakened, as it needs the once-for-all sense of Christ's unrepeated sacrifice ("al ofrecerse una vez a sí mismo"; better "una sola vez")
20.text: "from all eternity" is slightly reduced ("desde la eternidad"; better "desde toda la eternidad")
18.text: the technical term "actual transgressions" is rendered imprecisely, since the sense is committed sins as opposed to original sin ("transgresiones reales"; better "transgresiones actuales")
18.text: the feminine pronoun does not clearly refer to original sin and points instead to "corrupción" or "naturaleza" ("que de ella proceden")
20.text: "mere good pleasure" loses the established doctrinal term "beneplácito" ("por su puro agrado")
18.text: a comma wrongly separates the subject from its verb ("el hombre cayó, consiste")

25.text: the construction after "ejerce el oficio" is calqued on the English and reads awkwardly ("en su única ofrenda de sí mismo como sacrificio")
